Title: Stream Analytics offers streaming dashboards in Power BI

Body.Content: Azure Stream Analytics jobs can now output to the Power BI streaming datasets. For solutions that you build through Stream Analytics, you can take advantage of richly visual and dynamic dashboards with lower latency.
